question: After the complete terminal-hit precision/excess closure, can the owner-ordered cross-turn hold class support exactly one finite, source-compatible twelve-field Dusk-only fight-local contract before any support or simulator row is read?
hypothesis: The shortest directly attributable cross-turn primitive is to retain one authored Attack left in the end-turn hand, count it against the next normal draw and pay one Ember only when the exact UID is played on that immediately following turn.
claimBoundary: Exact-source, immutable-closure, finite-grammar legality and lexicographic representation selection only. No hold activation, support, causal endpoint, policy-control, complementarity, package, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or P9 claim.

scientificBasis.serialEntry: The exact-lethal and positive-overkill capacity summaries validly close the complete terminal-hit precision/excess class. Owner comment 5460811702 orders cross-turn hold next.
scientificBasis.observability: Current source directly exposes end-turn hand UIDs, discard UIDs, next-turn number, draw UIDs and legal play UIDs. One research event can label each causal stage without inferring identity.
scientificBasis.naturalCost: The retained Attack replaces one next-turn normal draw, was unavailable for prior-turn play or Kindle, and must be paid and legally played before one-turn expiry.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: Candidate construction and ordering use exact source, immutable aliases and the owner lexicographic objective only. No support row, frequency, outcome, card identity preference or optimiser is read.

forbiddenSelectors: a policy, seed, encounter or card subset

contract.producer: After hand penalties at Dusk END_TURN, select the first authored Attack remaining in existing hand order; at most one exact UID.
contract.mediatorState: Keep that UID in hand and store only {uid, cardId, createdTurn} in one ephemeral CombatState record while every unselected card follows current discard order.
contract.consumer: A successful legal PLAY of that exact UID at createdTurn plus one, after normal PLAY and Energy events and before authored effects.
contract.payoffOperation: Request gain_embers(run, cb, 1) exactly once and record requested one versus realised capped or tithed delta.
contract.lifecycle: Cross one enemy phase, replace one normal next-turn draw, consume on exact play and otherwise expire at Kindle/removal, next END_TURN, terminal combat, missing card or stale turn; never immediately re-hold an expired UID.
contract.naturalCost: Forgo the prior-turn play or Kindle, receive one fewer normal draw, then pay and legally play the exact retained Attack before expiry.
contract.duskBoundary: Aspect zero only; factor-on Ash is exact current-main with no state, event, draw, Ember, RNG or result movement.
contract.scorelineFactor: Separate closed Scoreline factor fixed off; no Oath, Faultline, Cracked, assignment or Scoreline payoff.
contract.afterimageFactor: Separate closed Afterimage factor fixed off; no Ward setup, Warden's Edge, order intervention or Afterimage payoff.
contract.interferenceRule: Preserve hand penalties, unselected discard order, start-turn effects, hand cap, Kindle, authored effects, Ember cap and tithe, Art, Momentum, Facet/Shatter, death, relics and RNG; exact UID only.
contract.nullPath: Omitted/off, B-only, Ash, no Attack, same-ID different-UID, stale turn and malformed or missing mediator are fail-closed exact nulls; no residue crosses a combat.
contract.policyExposure: Frozen existing policies first with no hold, score, acquisition or target control; direct telemetry records producer, mediator-set, carry/draw replacement, consumer, consume, payoff requested/realised and exact expiry.

candidateDesigns.rejection: Retaining the card while drawing the full next hand grants an extra card and fails the owner natural-cost requirement.

contract.producer: Same exact end-turn Attack selection as H1.
contract.mediatorState: Same exact one-turn hand record as H1.
contract.consumer: Same exact next-turn UID play plus a successful living-target Attack hit.
contract.payoffOperation: Add one Facet chip at deferred hit settlement.
contract.lifecycle: Same one-turn hold plus pending-chip settlement.
contract.naturalCost: Same prior-turn and draw-replacement cost as H1.
contract.interferenceRule: Additionally preserve target, hit, pending-chip, Facet and Shatter settlement.
contract.nullPath: Same H1 nulls plus missed, dead and absent target nulls.
contract.policyExposure: Existing policy first with additional target and hit telemetry.

contract.producer: Same end-turn Attack producer as H1.
contract.mediatorState: Retain one exact UID with a remaining-turn counter.
contract.consumer: Play that UID on any later turn before combat ends.
contract.lifecycle: Persist for more than one enemy phase and repeatedly replace draws.
contract.naturalCost: Repeated draw replacement and delayed play.

candidateDesigns.rejection: Variable-card retention and payoff cardinality are unbounded by the complete hand.
Moving the selected card through discard/draw and consuming its redraw overlays immutable draw-thread and reshuffle topology and mutates more zones.
A named pair and explicit selector choose product semantics and policy intervention before evidence and overlap closed order/action families.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one complete candidate is first under the frozen source-only lexicographic objective, every immutable source/evidence/candidate identity passes, no support or observation is read, ledger is byte-identical and execution completes within 20 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only dusk-one-turn-held-attack-play-ember-one for a separately preregistered source/interface/null and direct A/B/AB preflight. Add no whole-run row, policy control, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: No candidate passes every zero-row legality and alias gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close cross-turn hold lifecycle at the zero-row boundary and continue serially with intent-history lifecycle inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Frozen source/evidence cannot distinguish otherwise legal candidates, an immutable identity fails or the exact decision is unavailable at 20 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record cross-turn hold design inconclusive at the frozen zero-row cap. Do not choose by taste, read support, rerun, add a method or use protected seeds.
